name: tabbyrdp
description: Remote desktop streaming with a browser-based viewer and mobile auth key

scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:infra && npm run build:agent
scripts.test: npm run test:infra && npm run test:agent && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:testServer
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix infra
scripts.cdk:synth: npm run cdk --prefix infra -- synth --context env=dev
scripts.cdk:synth:prod: npm run cdk --prefix infra -- synth --context env=prod
